details_ru: Режим 1 — NV; 2 — NV alpha two-pass; 3 — ARB; 4 — fixed-function alpha. Различаются color masks и blend states.

details_ru: При >=4 TMU tuple 1,7,4,6; при 3 TMU ambient отложен; при 2 TMU diffuse и ambient отложены. Затем выполняется умножение base/detail.

functions.summary_ru: Накладывает base/detail поверх накопленного статического и динамического освещения.
details_ru: Blend DST_COLOR,SRC_COLOR даёт 2*base*light; detail modulate имеет RGB scale 2. Это важно для точной яркости фонаря.

functions.summary_ru: HUD radial zoom blur consumes the same live capture texture as cam_vfind, independently of TakePhoto.
details_ru: 10072740 calls after frame-delta update and10072470, before subsequent HUD elements. Requires gl_screenblur, nonzero delta, and blurtest/server Blur/waterlevel>2/damage deadline condition; captures full screen through10064c10.

Checks live texture ID104d26e8!=0 rather than ready104d26e5; does not clear ready. Expanding centered quads use same captured texture, flipped V, white modulation, gl_opacity and SRC_ALPHA/ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA; texgen S/T disabled.

Not a scene render or temporal history buffer. Immediate preceding10072470 is an empty return, so no hidden capture/render stage exists there. External engine world/viewmodel/HUD ordering remains separate from this resolved client scheduling.
Caller clamps negative frame delta only after this blur call; condition is delta!=0, not delta>0. Steps/opacity do not scale by delta. HUD times+30f0/+30f4 are floats, double delta stored+30f8.

Previously recovered trigger fields retained: DAT1018d270=HUD+31b0 is received Blur byte; DAT1054506c is integer waterlevel; HUD+328 is absolute damage deadline. See blur-triggers.md for producers and reset limits.
Baseline opacity0.5 and steps32/24 scale against640x480; controls and exact draw math remain documented in shader-pass-contracts.md. This is a static contract, not an integrated native blur pass.

functions.summary_ru: Live framebuffer copy shared by camera viewfinder and HUD screen blur.
details_ru: Lazy ID104d26e8, ready104d26e5; initial256x256 RGB black texture, LINEAR filters. Every call saves binding104d26ec, binds live ID, copies centered requested dimensions and sets ready1. Dimensions are not fixed256x256 after copy.

cam_vfind calls with material dimensions only when cl_cameraeffect!=0; consumes ready and sets a local restoration flag. HUD10071df0 calls full screen dimensions, checks texture ID rather than ready and leaves ready untouched.

No new scene draw, FBO, camera orientation, read-buffer selection or viewport-origin addition. Dispatch101be670 is proven glCopyTexImage2D; dimensions are engine SCREENINFO. External engine ordering/read-buffer state remain unresolved, so source cannot be called a clean world-only/final/previous frame.
Typed native refs show exactly two returned direct call sites10066b77 within10065ef0 and10071e88 within10071df0. Both known consumers are accounted for; computed calls are not excluded.

Dimensions1018f430/434 are SCREENINFO width/height: HUD_VidInit sets ECX1018a0c0 ->1006d9e0 calls GetScreenInfo101b2638(this+536c), sets size214h. API base101b2608 slot12 and SDK SCREENINFO layout prove source; not a GL viewport query.

Dispatch proof: HUD1006dcc7 passes manager ECX101be5f8 to100556f0; preserved object passed to10053c80; named GetProcAddress(module+210,"glCopyTexImage2D") stores this+78=101be670. This resolves pointer identity without claiming external GL framebuffer state.
Copy region origin is screenWidth/2-width/2, screenHeight/2-height/2; initial temporary CPU allocation is freed after RGB upload.

functions.summary_ru: Создаёт массив вершин и per-face TBN из texinfo и плоскостей BSP.
details_ru: T и B — отдельно нормализованные vecs[0]/vecs[1] texinfo; N — plane normal с инверсией при PLANEBACK. Нет отдельной инверсии Y, cross product или Gram-Schmidt.
Stride вершины 28 байт; запись грани 40 байт: normal +4, T +16, B +28; сохраняет исходные base/lightmap UV.
